properties.decision:
Anthony, 2026-10-25: "Yes, do all: ... the occurrence shape". This takes every recommendation of the shape set out for dec:a-dated-occurrence-records-an-event-in-the-designs-world:
- NAME: `Occurrence`. It does not clash with ChangeEvent, and it stays domain-neutral.
- DATES: `starts` required and `ends` optional, each an ISO day or a date-time with offset, plus an optional IANA `time_zone`. A day stays a day, never turned into UTC midnight. No repeat rules yet: Alex's 20 meets are 20 dates.
- LINKS: ABOUT_ENTITY widened so an Occurrence can be about what it concerns, and SCHEDULED_FOR widened so an item can be due by an Occurrence ("the bleachers are ready by the home opener").
- READ-BACK: upcoming, today or past, worked out when read in the MCP layer from a clock it names (as findings' age_days already are), never stored; scan_nodes can sort by date.
- CONSTRUCTOR: the existing create_node, with the schema checking the date format. No tool #201. find_tools learns to rank node types the way it now ranks relations (dec:find-tools-also-finds-relations-and-points-to-what-joins-x-to-y), the same two-halves gap. A typed tool is added only if usage shows people struggling.
- EXISTING MILESTONE EPOCHS: a read-only advisory finds dates written in an epoch's text and proposes the calls to the owner (make the Occurrence, link the epoch to it with EVOLVES_INTO, retire the epoch only on their word). No migration touches anyone's design.
properties.name: The dated occurrence's shape: an Occurrence node with a start and an optional end (each a day or a date-time with offset, plus an optional time zone; no repeats yet), linked by ABOUT_ENTITY and reachable by SCHEDULED_FOR, read back as upcoming, today or past from a stated clock, made with create_node, with a read-only advisory for undated milestone epochs (not built yet)
properties.rationale: The shape rests on Alex's wrestling schedule (20 milestone epochs, each date only in prose) and on keeping the tool count flat. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_018ibUbMKCS1yK5W17cncp9P
